synopsis.text: Medusa has come to Earth on a goodwill mission on behalf of the Inhumans. But is that's the case, why is she slugging it out with Spidey?

Whilst swinging around town, Spider-Man bumps into Medusa of the Inhumans. She has come to Manhattan to see if the world is ready for the Inhumans to join it. Medusa flies down to the street, and explains what she wants. An agent from a hair product company offers her a job, and Medusa agrees, since it will give her a good chance to see what humans are like. After a while, Medusa gets bored and quits the job. The hair product company makes it look like she smashed up the place, and tell Spider-Man (who is swinging by) to go stop her. Spider-Man and Medusa fight, until Medusa mentions that the Inhumans hate violence. Spider-Man realises that the hair product company set him up, and so they stop fighting.
